records.topic: Eighth-lord conjunction versus eighth-lord aspect changes predicate

witness_a.predicate: Tenth lord joined Saturn and conjoined eighth lord

witness_b.predicate: Tenth lord joined Saturn and aspected by eighth lord

records.result_class: Harsh-official-orders historical claim; not personal moral profiling
records.relationship: The same verse family contains semantically different source predicates. A real conjunction need not be an aspect, and an aspect need not be a conjunction; source-winner not selected.
records.mechanics_unfrozen: Definition of sambandha, lord computation, separate cruel-navamsa versus kendra alternatives, and sign versus degree aspects

records.topic: Foreign commerce not equivalent to residence abroad
records.source: JP_1922_PRINT Adhyaya XV v57 PDF318 printed922, Mars and Venus tenth from Moon
records.limitation: Not a direct observable without independently defining occupation, trade volume/period and opportunity; one trip or move is not a success.

records.topic: Profession labels broadened across text and commentarial notes
interpretive_issues: Printed v57 Mars+Mercury describes scientific knowledge in English whereas Sanskrit sastra requires historic context; not automatically modern laboratory science
Printed v59 Saturn+Venus English names cosmetic powder manufacturing and commerce while the Sanskrit includes terms associated with painting/commerce; broad OR outcome and translation layer
Repeated occupation sector labels cannot each count as independent success from one antecedent

records.source: Varahamihira Brihat Jataka X.4 plus Sastri printed JP XV.43 note PDF312 printed916
records.summary: Brihat Jataka X.4 allows resources determined in multiple ways by situated and strong planets; Sastri separately cites Bhattotpala citing Gargi for considering all relevant income indicators instead of one strongest planet
records.conclusion: Two supporting textual discussions of plural wealth sources; not proof of global method, still separate transfers and provenance
